This risk increases with age, particularly in females over 35 years of age, and with the number of cigarettes smoked. For this reason, CHCs, including NEXTSTELLIS, are contraindicated in females who are over 35 years of age and smoke. ( 1 ) Limitations of Use NEXTSTELLIS may be less effective in females with a BMI ≥ 30 kg/m 2 . In females with BMI ≥ 30 kg/m 2 , decreasing effectiveness may be associated with increasing BMI ( 14 ).
